arxiv-2011-10476.description: Abstract Here, we present a detailed theoretical and experimental study on the pressure induced switching of anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in the triangular antiferromagnetic (AFM) compound Mn 3 Sn. Our theoretical model suggests pressure driven significant splitting of the in-plane Mn bond lengths i . e . i.e.

arxiv-2208-05892.title: Search for LBVs in the Local Volume galaxies: study of four stars in NGC 4449 2021 Search for LBVs in the Local Volume galaxies: study of four stars in NGC 4449 – References
arxiv-2208-05892.creator: Y. Solovyeva, A. Vinokurov, A. Sarkisyan, A. Kostenkov, K. Atapin, S. Fabrika D. Oparin, A. Valeev, D. Bizyaev, P. Nedialkov, O. Spiridonova
arxiv-2208-05892.description: Abstract We continue to search for LBV stars in galaxies outside the Local Group. In this work, we have investigated four luminous stars in NGC 4449. Multiple spectral observations carried out for J122810.94+440540.6, J122811.70+440550.9, and J122809.72+440514.8 revealed the emission features in their spectra that are characteristic of LBVs. Photometry showed noticeable brightness changes of J122809.72+440514.

arxiv-2208-14443.title: Steady state correlations and induced trapping of an inertial AOUP particle
arxiv-2208-14443.creator: N Arsha, K P Jepsin, M Sahoo
arxiv-2208-14443.description: Abstract We study the dynamics of an inertial active Ornstein-Uhnlenbeck particle self-propelling in a confined harmonic well. The transport behaviour of the particle is investigated by analyzing the particle trajectories, steady state correlations, and mean square displacement (MSD). The steady state correlation functions for the position as well as velocity are exactly calculated using different methods.

arxiv-2305-03995.title: Attacking Pre-trained Recommendation DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation emai; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Computer systems organization Embedded systems
arxiv-2305-03995.creator: Yiqing Wu, Ruobing Xie, Zhao Zhang, Yongchun Zhu, Fuzhen Zhuang, Jie Zhou, Yongjun Xu, Qing He
arxiv-2305-03995.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yiqing Wu, Ruobing Xie, Zhao Zhang, Yongchun Zhu, Fuzhen Zhuang, Jie Zhou, Yongjun Xu, Qing He. Recently, a series of pioneer studies have shown the potency of pre-trained models in sequential recommendation, illuminating the path of building an omniscient unified pre-trained recommendation model for different downstream recommendation tasks. Despite these advancements, the vulnerabilities of classical recommender systems also exist in pre-trained recommendation in a new form, while the security of pre-trained recommendation model is still unexplored, which may threaten its widely practical applications.

arxiv-2408-09872.title: Space-time correlations in monitored kinetically constrained discrete-time quantum dynamics
arxiv-2408-09872.creator: Marcel Cech, María Cea, Mari Carmen Bañuls, Igor Lesanovsky, Federico Carollo
arxiv-2408-09872.description: Abstract State-of-the-art quantum simulators permit local temporal control of interactions and midcircuit readout. These capabilities open the way towards the exploration of intriguing nonequilibrium phenomena. We illustrate this with a kinetically constrained many-body quantum system that has a natural implementation on Rydberg quantum simulators.

arxiv-2410-00757.title: Collaborative motion planning for multi-manipulator systems through Reinforcement Learning and Dynamic Movement Primitives
arxiv-2410-00757.creator: Siddharth Singh, Tian Xu, Qing Chang
arxiv-2410-00757.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Siddharth Singh, Tian Xu, Qing Chang. Robotic tasks often require multiple manipulators to enhance task efficiency and speed, but this increases complexity in terms of collaboration, collision avoidance, and the expanded state-action space. To address these challenges, we propose a multi-level approach combining Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMP) to generate adaptive, real-time trajectories for new tasks in dynamic environments using a demonstration library. This method ensures collision-free trajectory generation and efficient collaborative motion planning.

arxiv-2510-22477.title: Agent-GSPO: Communication-Efficient Multi-Agent Systems via Group Sequence Policy Optimization
arxiv-2510-22477.creator: Yijia Fan; Jusheng Zhang; Jing Yang; Keze Wang
arxiv-2510-22477.description: Abstract To combat the prohibitive communication costs of “free-for-all” multi-agent systems (MAS), we introduce Agent-GSPO , a framework that directly optimizes for token economy using sequence-level reinforcement learning. Agent-GSPO leverages the stable and memory-efficient Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) algorithm to train agents on a communication-aware reward that explicitly penalizes verbosity.

arxiv-2601-13991.title: Generating Functions Meet Occupation Measures: Invariant Synthesis for Probabilistic Loops (Extended Version)
arxiv-2601-13991.creator: Darion Haase ( 🖂 ) {}^{(\text{\Letter})}, Kevin Batz, Adrian Gallus, Benjamin Lucien Kaminski, Joost-Pieter Katoen, Lutz Klinkenberg, Tobias Winkler
arxiv-2601-13991.description: Abstract A fundamental computational task in probabilistic programming is to infer a program’s output (posterior) distribution from a given initial (prior) distribution. This problem is challenging, especially for expressive languages that feature loops or unbounded recursion. While most of the existing literature focuses on statistical approximation, in this paper we address the problem of mathematically exact inference.

pmc-10545659.title: Definition of factor Xa inhibitor–related, life‐threatening gastrointestinal bleeding and guidance on when to use reversal therapy: A Delphi panel
pmc-10545659.creator: Gregory J Fermann, Brooks D Cash, Nayantara Coelho‐Prabhu, Marc Maegele, Roland Bingisser, Vinay Sehgal, Alexander T Cohen, Anna Hundt Golden, Jon Russo, Mark Price, Allen Mangel, Bruce Koch, Mary J Christoph, Truman J Milling
pmc-10545659.description: ObjectiveTo define and contextualize life‐threatening gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding in the setting of factor Xa (FXa) inhibitor therapy and to derive a consensus‐based, clinically oriented approach to the administration of FXa inhibitor reversal therapy.MethodsWe convened an expert panel of clinicians representing specialties in emergency medicine, gastroenterology, vascular medicine, and trauma surgery.

pmc-10596718.title: Forecasting of COVID-19 spread in Poland as part of health needs mapping
pmc-10596718.creator: K Witczak, M Raczyńska, M Kozioł-Rostkowska, A Śmiglewska
pmc-10596718.description: The development of a robust model for COVID-19 forecasting was a crucial task undertaken by the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Poland in response to the pandemic. High-quality forecasting rendered the inclusion of COVID-19 modelling in health needs assessment indispensable at the regional as well as country level.

pmc-10731441.title: Usefulness of core biopsy in diagnosis of pancreatic tumours
pmc-10731441.creator: Katarzyna Gwoździewicz, Michał Studniarek, Monika Czarnowska-Cubała, Joanna Pieńkowska, Karolina Markiet
pmc-10731441.description: PurposeThe aim of the study was to analyse the usefulness of core biopsy in the diagnosis of malignant neoplasms of the pancreas – sensitivity and accuracy of diagnosis, safety of the procedure, indication of factors that may increase the risk of complications after biopsy.

pmc-11494310.title: Injury-induced myosin-specific tissue-resident memory T cells drive immune checkpoint inhibitor myocarditis
pmc-11494310.creator: Hannah Kalinoski, Abdel Daoud, Vitali Rusinkevich, Ivana Jurčová, Monica V. Talor, Robin A. Welsh, David Hughes, Kateřina Zemanová, Ilja Stříž, Jody E. Hooper, Josef Kautzner, Petr Peichl, Vojtěch Melenovský, Taejoon Won, Daniela Čiháková
pmc-11494310.description: SignificanceWe determined that cardiac MyHC TRM cells are present in naive hearts and accumulate in the pericardial area in mice and humans after recovering from cardiac injury. TRM cells express high levels of PD-1, making them susceptible to activation by anti-PD-1 blocking antibodies. ICI-myocarditis is more prevalent after previous cardiac injury, demonstrating that TRM cells perpetuate the disease.

pmc-11495762.title: The tyrosine kinase Yes1 is a druggable host factor of HEV
pmc-11495762.creator: Jil Alexandra Haase, Abarna Baheerathan, Xin Zhang, Rebecca Menhua Fu, Maximilian Klaus Nocke, Charlotte Decker, Viet Loan Dao Thi, Daniel Todt, Johan Neyts, Suzanne JF Kaptein, Eike Steinmann, Volker Kinast
pmc-11495762.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:HEV is a positive-sense, single-stranded RNA virus of the Hepeviridae family. Although HEV accounts for more than 3 million symptomatic cases of viral hepatitis per year, specific anti-HEV therapy and knowledge about HEV pathogenesis are scarce.Methods:To gain a deeper understanding of the HEV infectious cycle and guide the development of novel antiviral strategies, we here used an RNAi mini screen targeting a selection of kinases, including mitogen-activated protein kinases, receptor tyrosine kinases, and Src-family kinases.

pmc-11674691.title: Changes in the Periodontal Gap After Long-Term Tooth Movement into Augmented Critical-Sized Defects in the Jaws of Beagle Dogs
pmc-11674691.creator: Kathrin Duske, Mareike Warkentin, Anja Salbach, Jan-Hendrik Lenz, Franka Stahl
pmc-11674691.description: Background/Objectives: Extensive and closely coordinated remodeling processes take place in the periodontal ligament (PDL) and the adjacent bone during orthodontic tooth movement. In complex orthodontic cases, it is necessary to move teeth into an augmented bony defect, for example, in patients with cleft lip, alveolus, and palate.

pmc-11879391.title: Construction of chiral crown ethers in robust covalent organic frameworks for electrochromatographic enantioseparation
pmc-11879391.creator: Shiguo Fu, Gaizhao Qin, Jinqiao Dong, Chen Yuan, Yan Liu, Li-Ming Yuan, Yong Cui
pmc-11879391.description: Capillary electrochromatography (CEC) is a rapidly emerging separation technique that merges the high separation efficiency of capillary electrophoresis with the exceptional selectivity of liquid chromatography. However, it remains a synthetic challenge to design functional chiral stationary phases (CSPs) with high chemical stability against acid and base in CEC enantioseparation.

pmc-12403270.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundRoutine use of brief, structured screening tools is essential to detect and provide support for Australians who drink above recommended levels. However, detecting drinking above recommended levels in Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australian primary care settings is complex.

pmc-12472973.title: Maternal Folic Acid Supplementation, Perinatal Factors, and Pre-Adolescent Asthma: Findings from the Healthy Growth Study
pmc-12472973.creator: Eva Karaglani, Maria Michelle Papamichael, Matzourana Argyropoulou, Dimitra-Irinna Vitoratou, Costas Anastasiou, Mehak Batra, Yibeltal Bekele, Bircan Erbas, Yannis Manios, George Moschonis, Le Ma
pmc-12472973.description: Background: While the importance of folic acid supplementation during pregnancy in the prevention of neural tube defects in offspring is well established, its potential role in pediatric asthma development remains unclear, with limited evidence to date. Objective: To identify perinatal and environmental factors that modify the association between maternal folic acid intake and pre-adolescent asthma.

pmc-12971966.title: Effectiveness of symptom perception interventions among patients with heart failure: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12971966.creator: Xiangyu Wang, Guangju Wang, Yichen Liu, Liwen Xia, Yingnan Zhao, Lifen Mao, Xiaoqing Shi, Rulan Yin
pmc-12971966.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAlthough symptom perception appears promising for enhancing health-related quality of life in patients with heart failure (HF), no quantitative pooling of effect sizes has been described to summarize and test its efficacy on clinical outcomes.

pmc-13359523.title: Safety and Treatment Discontinuation of Novel Hormonal Therapies in Metastatic Hormone-Sensitive Prostate Cancer: An Exploratory Real-World Study
pmc-13359523.creator: Irene Millan-Ramos, Alberto Zambudio-Munuera, Miguel Herraez-Marcos, Antonio Jimenez-Pacheco, Francisco Gutierrez-Tejero, Miguel Arrabal-Martin, Miguel Angel Arrabal-Polo
pmc-13359523.description: Simple SummaryTreatment for metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer has changed substantially in recent years with the introduction of novel hormonal therapies administered with androgen deprivation therapy, with or without docetaxel. However, patients treated in routine clinical practice are often more complex than those included in clinical trials.

pmc-13381908.title: Glucuronidation metabolomic fingerprinting to map host-microbe metabolism
pmc-13381908.creator: Nina R Boyle, Josh J Sekela, Mingxun Wang, Helena Mannochio-Russo, Jeong Joo Pyo, Min Soo Kim, Shuchang Tian, Imhoi Koo, Elliot S Friedman, Ceylan Tanes, Mallappa Anitha, Yuan Tian, Ethan W Morgan, Iain A Murray, Joseph P Zackular, Kyle Bittinger, James D Lewis, Gary H Perdew, Gary D Wu, Babette S Z
pmc-13381908.description: Glucuronidation is an important detoxification pathway that operates in balance with gastrointestinal microbial β-glucuronidase (GUS) activity, which can regenerate bioactive metabolites from their glucuronidated forms. How this host-microbe interaction shapes the distribution and pool of glucuronidated metabolites (i.e., the glucuronidome) remains poorly understood.
